title: XRT Green Mode
objective: Place an AMX learning station safely, complete the guided interaction, and issue portable mission proof.

steps.title: Confirm the room model
steps.prompt: Use MRUK to identify the floor, walls, and a clear learning zone.

steps.title: Place the learning station
steps.prompt: Anchor the station inside the safe zone using hands or controllers.

steps.title: Complete the guided checkpoint
steps.prompt: Ask JAZ for the objective and complete the hand-tracked interaction.

steps.title: Review and issue proof
steps.prompt: Confirm the evidence and synchronize the OPPRRC completion record.
